name: A New Dawn
source:
A New Dawn is a furry gay (Very NSFW) visual novel focused on you as the main character who has just moved to a new city and is starting his first year of college. Throughout the story you will meet various characters who will conveniently develop feelings for you as you get to know them.

[From [url=https://polarwolf-team.itch.io/a-new-dawn-vn]Itch.io[/url]]
